extension.description: Audit, lint, synchronize, and optimize AI context files (copilot-instructions, CLAUDE.md, GEMINI.md, etc.) to reduce token consumption.
command.showAuditReport: AI Context Optimizer: Show Audit Report
command.initInstructions: AI Context Optimizer: Initialize Copilot Instructions
command.syncTools: AI Context Optimizer: Synchronize AI Context Files
config.threshold: Maximum recommended lines for auto-loaded context files. Files exceeding this trigger optimization warnings.
config.maxFiles: Maximum files to match per context pattern during scan. Increase for very large monorepos.
config.excludeGlob: Glob pattern used to exclude directories from scans.
tool.apply.displayName: Preview or Apply Optimized Context Files
tool.sync.displayName: Synchronize AI Context Files Across Tools
participant.description: Audit and optimize AI context files to reduce token consumption. Use when: context audit, optimize copilot instructions, reduce tokens, compact instructions, deduplicate context.
cmd.audit: Audit all AI context files and report token costs (read-only)
cmd.compare: Show before/after projection without applying changes
cmd.apply: Preview and apply optimized file changes with confirmation
cmd.sync: Synchronize instructions across Copilot, Claude, Gemini and AGENTS.md
cmd.init: Scaffold optimized context files from your project metadata
